description: This file defines the MemoryAdapterFactory class, a generic class implementing multiple interfaces related to stream adapter creation, caching, and message queuing within the Orleans framework. It manages in-memory stream queues, buffer pools, and failure handling, primarily used for testing purposes.

classes.name: MemoryAdapterFactory`1
classes.description: A factory class for creating in-memory stream adapters in Orleans, supporting caching, queue management, and failure handling, mainly used for testing scenarios.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes internal data structures, cache monitors, and stream queue mapper.

methods.name: CreateBufferPoolIfNotCreatedYet
methods.description: Creates a buffer pool if it hasn't been initialized yet.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Returns a task that provides the current instance as an IQueueAdapter.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the current instance as an IQueueAdapterCache.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the stream queue mapper instance.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a new MemoryAdapterReceiver for a specified queue ID.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Queues a batch of messages asynchronously for a given stream ID.

methods.name: CreateQueueCache
methods.description: Creates a cache for a specific queue ID.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Returns a failure handler for message delivery, defaulting to a no-op handler.

methods.name: GenerateDeterministicGuid
methods.description: Generates a deterministic GUID based on the queue ID and factory name hash.

methods.name: GetQueueGrain
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a grain instance for a specific queue ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate and initialize a MemoryAdapterFactory with dependency injection.
